[Bugfix] fp8_gemm_4wave (gfx950): at the top of each main-loop step a wave refills an A buffer in LDS while another wave may still be reading it
[Bugfix] mxfp_moe stage-1 GEMM at BM=128: the two-slot A ring lets one wave's copy overwrite LDS rows that other waves have not read yet
[Bugfix] moe_gemm_2stage stage-1 GEMM with tile_m=16 (or 48): each A-tile LDS buffer is smaller than one copy, so a copy into a_ping overwrites a_pong while other waves still read it
[Bugfix] conv3d_implicit_fp8: the pipeline drain reads the last K tile from LDS before its direct-to-LDS copies have landed
[Bugfix] custom all-reduce, write mode: the "stage 1 done" and "done" flags are published before the data they announce has arrived
[Bugfix] custom all-reduce, 2-stage kernel: the all-gather for sizes that do not split evenly reads packs its handshake does not cover (and puts partitions in the wrong order on ranks > 0)
[Bugfix] custom all-reduce: the 1-stage kernel has no end handshake, so back-to-back calls can add a peer's *next* input
[Bugfix] pa_decode_sw_kernel (sliding-window decode): the per-row score maxima overwrite the query scales in LDS before every wave has read them
[Bugfix] pa_decode_tile_kernel (16/64-token pages): the first loop iteration overwrites the V page ids in LDS before every wave has read them
[Bugfix] pa_decode_metadata_kernel (persistent paged-attention decode): the next work item's query is written over P that another wave may still be reading
[Bugfix] mla_fwd_decode_m16x8_fp8_fp8: a wave that starts the next work item overwrites KV buffer 0 while other waves still use it for the previous item
[Bugfix] flash_attn_fp8_gfx950: with the dual-wave stagger, half of the waves read K/V tiles from LDS before the other half's copies have landed
[Bugfix] gemm_a16w16 (gfx950, half-tile-interleaved): B half 0 is refilled in LDS while the other wave group may still be reading it
